description.zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**配置管理** > **媒资管理配置** > **分类管理**查看分类ID。
- 通过[创建分类](~~56401~~)接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
- 通过[获取分类及子分类](~~56406~~)接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the category. Obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). Choose **Configuration Management** > **Media Asset Management** > **Category Management** to view the category ID.

- The response to an [AddCategory](~~56401~~) call contains the category ID in the \`CateId\` parameter.

- The response to a [GetCategories](~~56406~~) call contains the category ID in the \`CateId\` parameter.
The URL of the cover for the audio or video file.

description.zh:
音/视频描述。

- 长度不超过1024个字节。
- UTF-8编码。
description.en:
The description of the audio or video file.

- The description can be up to 1,024 bytes in length.

- The description must be UTF-8 encoded.

description.zh: 自定义 ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一。
description.en: A custom ID. The ID can contain lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The ID must be 6 to 64 characters in length and unique for each user.

description.zh:
标签。

- 单个标签不超过32字节。最多不超过16个标签。
- 多个标签之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
- UTF-8编码。
description.en:
The tags of the file.

- A single tag can be up to 32 bytes in length. A maximum of 16 tags are supported.

- Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

- The tags must be UTF-8 encoded.

description.zh:
音/视频标题。

- 长度不超过128个字节。
- UTF-8编码。
description.en:
The title of the audio or video file.

- The title can be up to 128 bytes in length.

- The title must be UTF-8 encoded.

description.zh: 自定义设置。为 JSON 字符串，支持消息回调、上传加速等设置。更多信息，请参见 [UserData](~~86952~~)。
description.en: Custom settings in a JSON string. These settings can include message callbacks and upload acceleration. For more information, see [UserData](~~86952~~).

description.zh:
音/视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看音/视频ID。
- 通过[获取视频上传地址和凭证](~~55407~~)接口获取上传地址和凭证时，音/视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[搜索媒体信息](~~86044~~)接口查询音/视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the audio or video file. Obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- Log on to the [VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com). Choose **Media Library** > **Audio/Video** to view the ID of a video that was uploaded in the console.

- The response to a [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) call contains the audio or video ID in the \`VideoId\` parameter.

- After you upload a video, the response to a [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) call contains the audio or video ID in the \`VideoId\` parameter.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
通过视频ID来定位音/视频，支持修改音/视频的标题、标签、描述等信息，传入参数则更新相应字段，否则该字段不会被覆盖或更新。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~342790~~)。
descriptions.en:
### Usage notes

This operation updates the information of an audio or video file based on its video ID, such as the title, tags, and description. If you include a parameter in the request, the corresponding field is updated. Fields for omitted parameters remain unchanged.

### QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API operation is 100 for each user. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~342790~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod update-video-info --video-id 2deda93265312baf9b0ed810d0000 --title Alibaba_Cloud_VOD_Video_Title --tags tag1,tag2 --description Alibaba_Cloud_VOD_video_description --cover-url https://example.aliyundoc.com/0000.jpg --cate-id 384761111 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_00000_,_test_:_www --reference-id 123-123 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vod UpdateVideoInfo --region cn-hangzhou --VideoId 2deda93265312baf9b0ed810d0000 --Description Alibaba_Cloud_VOD_video_description --ReferenceId '123-123' --UserData 'MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://example.aliyundoc.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_00000_,_test_:_www' --Title Alibaba_Cloud_VOD_Video_Title --CoverURL 'https://example.aliyundoc.com/0000.jpg' --CateId 384761111 --Tags 'tag1,tag2'
